Docket 1.3.113

**Docket is free to try: run a full audit of any site without a key and see your score, how many problems each area has, and the most important problem in full with its fix. [Buy it once](https://kerr-affiliate-hub.kerrco.workers.dev/buy/docket?src=release-notes), $349, or 4 payments of $87.25, to see all the others, the ranked fix plan and the markup to paste. 30-day refund, no conditions.**

- *A quoted "coming soon" is no longer read as an unfinished page.* A page that quoted the words, for example to
  say what another page used to say, could be reported as containing placeholder text when "this page" appeared
  nearby. Quoted words are now read as what they are: something being reported. A page that says it is itself
  unfinished is still reported.
- *Two H1s that say the same thing are no longer reported as "more than one H1".* A page whose print-only header
  repeats the main heading word for word was told its H1s blur what the page is about. They name one topic, so the
  page is no longer counted. A page whose H1s say different things is still reported.
- *A link whose server hangs up on Docket is no longer called broken.* Some sites accept the connection and close it
  without answering when the request comes from an audit tool, while a browser gets the page. Those links were
  reported as broken. They are now listed as outbound links Docket could not check, the same as a link that answers
  "forbidden" or "too many requests". A link whose server cannot be reached at all is still reported as broken.

99 checks across 13 areas.
